text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by the Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot ouch for their accuracy.
- Ambassadors to France, Belgium and Italy have been nominated.
- Border talks between Russia and Latvia continue today on technical details and the agreement is close to initialing.
- UNICEF criticises reforms in eastern Europe and the Baltics which leaves many children being supported by only one parent.
